questions.question: A Stage III Ravage lists Sands and Jungles. Before it starts one matching land is empty. A triggered effect during another Ravage moves an Invader into that empty land and more Invaders into a land already due to Ravage. Which lands Ravage and which Invaders participate?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A Stage III Ravage lists Sands and Jungles. Before it starts one matching land is empty. A triggered effect during another Ravage moves an Invader into that empty land and more Invaders into a land already due to Ravage. Which lands Ravage and which Invaders participate?
required_facts: Determine the matching lands eligible to Ravage before resolving that card.
The initially empty land does not begin Ravaging when an Invader later arrives.
New Invaders entering an already queued land participate when that land Ravages.

key_context_not_required.fact: Players may choose any order across both terrains.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: It asks eligible lands and participating Invaders; it does not ask players to choose or describe land order.

questions.question: Bringer uses a 2-Damage Power and then a separate 1-Damage Power on an undamaged City. What happens? What if 2 then 1 Damage are instructions within a single Power, and may a Repeat pretend-destroy the same piece again?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Bringer uses a 2-Damage Power and then a separate 1-Damage Power on an undamaged City. What happens? What if 2 then 1 Damage are instructions within a single Power, and may a Repeat pretend-destroy the same piece again?
required_facts: Separate 2- and 1-Damage Bringer Powers each fail to pretend-destroy an undamaged City and leave no hypothetical Damage.
A single Power with 2 then 1 Damage combines its instructions and pretend-destroys that City for 5 Fear without actual destruction.
A Repeat is a separate use and can pretend-destroy the same piece again if that use suffices.
Hypothetical Damage cannot combine across the original and Repeat.

questions.question: What is the order of the Invader Phase, and if a Blighted Island start-of-phase effect destroys a Spirit’s last Presence, may an earned Fear Card resolve first to avert defeat?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: What is the order of the Invader Phase, and if a Blighted Island start-of-phase effect destroys a Spirit’s last Presence, may an earned Fear Card resolve first to avert defeat?
required_facts: Invader Phase order is Blighted Island instructions, earned Fear, Ravage, Build, Explore, advance cards.
Complete the start-of-phase Blighted effect tree and check outcomes before Fear.
If the Spirit still has no island Presence and there is no simultaneous victory, lose before the earned Fear card can resolve.
Do not reorder Fear ahead of the Blighted instruction to avert defeat.

questions.question: For a standard game, how many balanced Island Boards are used and chosen, how are their initial Invaders, Dahan and Blight placed, and how are the Minor/Major decks and shared piece supplies prepared?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: For a standard game, how many balanced Island Boards are used and chosen, how are their initial Invaders, Dahan and Blight placed, and how are the Minor/Major decks and shared piece supplies prepared?
required_facts: Randomly choose one balanced Island Board per Spirit and assemble the island.
Populate all lands using printed Invader, Dahan and Blight setup icons.
Take setup island Blight from the box rather than the pool.
Shuffle Minor and Major decks separately and provide separate shared discard spaces.
Prepare accessible shared supplies of Energy, Invaders and Dahan.

key_context_not_required.fact: Setup Blight does not cascade or destroy Presence.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The question asks island/supply preparation and placement, not an interaction involving setup Blight consequences.

questions.question: For Song of Sanctity, what happens if the target land contains an Explorer, and what happens if it contains none? May the player select the Blight-removal branch while Explorers are present?

required_facts: If Explorers are present, Push all of them.
If there are no Explorers, instead remove one Blight.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: May choose the otherwise branch while Explorers remain?
required_facts: No; the actual Explorer condition selects the branch, rather than a free player choice.
